description.narrative: The most significant expected project-level outcome is increased access to finance for SMEs in Bangladesh. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that its financing, via demonstration and replication channels, will contribute to building resilience of the SME finance market.

The proposed project consists of a senior loan of up to US$50 million to Bank Asia PLC (Bank Asia or Bank) in Bangladesh with a tenor of two years and with an option to rollover for an additional two years for a maximum tenor of four years. The proceeds of the investment will be used to meet the bank's immediate liquidity needs and extend loans to eligible sub-borrowers (export/import-based SMEs as per IFCs definition of targeted sectors) through its offshore banking units (OBU) to enable the Bank to continue to support key sectors of the Bangladeshi economy affected by COVID-19 and the subsequent global economic headwinds. The Project will be supported by a pooled first loss guarantee of up to US$40 million provided by International Development Agency IDA Private Sector Window Blended Finance Facility (IDA-PSW BFF).
